business.name: GAURANFUCKING TEA
business.category: Tea shop and VHS ad counter
business.tagline: We guarantee you'll like it, or else fuck you.
business.description: A cheerful tea counter with the least reassuring guarantee on the block. Lin performs the slogan outside while Mara and Eli keep the actual service warmer than the advertising.
ads: We guarantee you'll like it, or else fuck you.
NOW WITH A PAUSE LONG ENOUGH TO RECONSIDER THE SLOGAN.
PressureTV special: one cup, three takes, zero indoor voices.

interior.style: Warm counter, tea tins, and a deliberately overplayed VHS monitor
interior.description: A compact tasting counter faces a shelf of fictional tins. A small television loops ad cards. Plain text signs carry the joke; no recovered logo is imitated.

brand.name: GAURANFUCKING TEA
brand.tagline: We guarantee you'll like it, or else fuck you.
brand.summary: A tea brand whose excessive satisfaction guarantee powers chaotic 1990s VHS-style commercials.

staff.name: Mara Costa
staff.role: Owner and reluctant face of the guarantee
staff.greeting: Welcome. The tea is hot. The guarantee is unnecessarily personal.
staff.farewell: Come back. Tell me what you actually liked this time.

staff.name: Lin Qiao
staff.greeting: You heard the slogan from across the street. That means I’m doing my job.
staff.farewell: Try the tea. If you quote me, at least get the timing right.

staff.name: Eli Mensah
staff.greeting: If you want the ad, Lin is outside. If you want a recommendation, tell me what you like.
staff.farewell: Enjoy it. An honest opinion is more useful than a five-star reflex.

items.name: Guaranteed Tea Cup
items.description: A virtual tea collectible with the whole guarantee printed much too small. Inventory keepsake; no timed buff.

items.name: Tracking Error Sticker
items.description: A fictional VHS-style tea sticker for the inventory collection.

items.name: Or Else Shirt
items.description: A virtual shirt collectible quoting the shop’s aggressive guarantee; wardrobe application is not implied.
